# Jupyter Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.jupyter` |
| Source | `09_docker/jupyter.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, dev |

Jupyter notebook server with the local fabric Python project installed editable. The
build context is the repo root and the running container mounts the host repo over
/workspace so notebook edits stay in sync with source files.

### Inputs

| `DATA_PATH` | `string` | yes | `-` | Host path for user notebook work (binds to /home/jovyan/work in container) |
| `JUPYTER_PORT` | `string` | no | `8888` | Host port to expose the Jupyter server (default 8888) |
| `JUPYTER_TOKEN` | `string` | no | `localfabric-dev` | Auth token for the Jupyter server |


### Variables

| Name | YAML Type | Value / Template | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image_tag` | `str` | `contentgraph-jupyter:local` | - |
| `dockerfile_body` | `str` | `FROM jupyter/base-notebook:latest  USER root  # Install the project editably at build time. The build context is the repo # root; the compose file sets it that way. Copying the repo into /workspace # and running pip install -e writes a .pth into /opt/conda's site-packages # that points at /workspace. At runtime the compose file bind-mounts the # host repo over /workspace, replacing this build-time copy with live source # while the .pth (in the image's site-packages, outside /workspace) keeps # pointing at /workspace — so imports resolve against the live mount and # edits flow both ways. COPY . /workspace RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -e "/workspace[notebook]" \     && chown -R ${NB_UID}:${NB_GID} /workspace  USER ${NB_UID} ` | - |
| `services` | `dict` | `{'jupyter': {'build': {'context': '../../..', 'dockerfile': '09_services/dev/jupyter/Dockerfile'}, 'container_name': 'contentgraph-jupyter', 'restart': 'unless-stopped', 'ports': ['{{ JUPYTER_PORT }}:8888'], 'environment': {'JUPYTER_TOKEN': '{{ JUPYTER_TOKEN }}'}, 'volumes': ['../../..:/workspace', '{{ DATA_PATH }}:/home/jovyan/work'], 'command': ['start-notebook.py', '--ServerApp.root_dir=/workspace/15_notebooks']}}` | - |
